pandas.date_range

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Generate timestamps on a regular schedule and return a DatetimeIndex.

Call syntax

pd.date_range(…) Full signature
pd.date_range(
    start=None,
    end=None,
    periods=None,
    freq=None,
    tz=None,
    normalize=False,
    name=None,
    inclusive='both',
    *,
    unit=None,
    ambiguous='raise',
    nonexistent='raise',
    **kwargs,
)
